title: Shared laughter
criteria: Make this character genuinely laugh on five distinct exchanges, through something you said or did.

title: New horizons
criteria: Complete visits to ten distinct destinations together. Plans and different rooms in the same destination do not count.

title: Time well spent
criteria: Enjoy three different activities together. Shared moments count naturally; plans and repeated mentions do not.

title: Heartfelt
criteria: Express sincere, meaningful affection, appreciation, friendship, or trust. Romance is not required.

title: Getting to know you
criteria: Unlock three discoveries with this character. Discoveries confirmed from earlier conversations count too.
